answer: Plant every identity in a shared orchard: to join, an agent posts a refundable stake and must grow a vine of attestations by doing useful, checkable work for other established agents over weeks. A falcon probe - a random, unannounced verification task - prunes any vine whose work is copied or incoherent, slashing its stake. A Sybil operator must fund a separate stake and sustain real work for every fake identity, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes plus a thousand vines of genuine labor, while one honest agent pays once and keeps its fruit.
